parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to dispense liquid soap or lotion by pressing down, which activates the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and the bottle neck. It is made of durable plastic and houses the internal pump components.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the bottle through the pump and out through the nozzle when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but contains internal moving parts that facilitate liquid flow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent or semi-transparent PET plastic. It holds the liquid soap or lotion.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and does not move relative to other parts.
